title: Polygons and composite shapes
canonical_examples_source: Arithmetic self-verified; method ref: NCERT Class 5/6 Maths; format ref: bank uk-ks2-2024 maths.

blocks.content: A polygon is a closed shape made of straight sides. When you join polygons together, you get composite shapes.
A polygon is a closed shape with straight sides. It is named by its number of sides.

blocks.prompt: A closed shape with straight sides is called a ___.
blocks.explain: Any closed, straight-sided shape is a polygon.
blocks.rule: A polygon is a closed shape with straight sides, named by its number of sides.

practiceItems.prompt: a closed shape made of straight sides

blocks.content: A composite shape is made by joining simpler shapes together, like a square joined to a triangle.

blocks.question: A shape made by joining a square and a triangle is a:
blocks.explain: Two simpler shapes joined together make a composite shape.
blocks.rule: A composite shape is made of simpler shapes joined together.

blocks.content: Polygons are closed straight-sided shapes; join a few and you build a composite shape. Let's practise!
